title: gspg preview manifest
description: Which repositories get a generated social preview, and how each one looks.

title.description: Headline. Defaults to the repository name.

description.description: Sub-headline. Never truncated: the layout shrinks the type until the whole text fits. Kept across `gspg import`.

language.description: Shown in the gallery, not on the image.

pattern.description: Background field. Defaults to 'strata' for every repository, which is what makes the set look like one family.

accent.description: Hue name (amber, azure, crimson, cyan, emerald, indigo, lime, magenta, teal, violet), a hue in degrees, or a hex colour. Drives the spine and the paper tint.

saturation.description: Scales chroma across the palette. 0 is monochrome.

seed.description: Overrides the seed. Change it to reroll the colour without renaming.

defaults.description: Applied to every entry that does not set the field itself.

repo.description: owner/name, exactly as it appears on GitHub.
